description: List a wallet's recent transfers of one ERC-20 token (default USDC) on Avalanche, in and out, over the last N blocks (1-2,000, default 1,000): direction, counterparty, amount and transaction, newest first, up to 50. Use to confirm a payment arrived or see what was sent; for the current balance use avax_token_balance. Malformed addresses are rejected with 400, uncharged. Example: address=0xd8dA6BF26964aF9D7eEd9e03E53415D37aA96045. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

blocks.description: How many recent blocks to scan (1-2000, default 1000; 2,000 blocks is about 32 minutes on Avalanche)

token.description: Token: a ticker such as USDT or WETH, or the 0x ERC-20 contract (default: USDC on this network)

name: avax_token_transfers
title: Token transfers, Avalanche
